questions.q: Why is the book called Numbers?
questions.a: It counts Israel in two censuses
w: It counts the years in Egypt

questions.q: How many men of war were numbered in the first census?
acc: six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty

questions.q: The blessing Aaron was to speak — complete it.
questions.text: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee: The LORD make his face [shine] upon thee, and be [gracious] unto thee: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee [peace].

questions.q: How many men did Moses send to search the land of Canaan?
questions.x: Of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man.

questions.q: Which two spies urged Israel to go up and possess the land?
What did the spies carry back between two on a staff?

Whose rod budded, bloomed blossoms and yielded almonds?
Why was Moses kept from bringing Israel into the land?
questions.a: He struck the rock instead of speaking to it
w: He broke the tables of stone
He was afraid of the giants
questions.x: Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel.

questions.q: What did Moses set on a pole so that the bitten who looked on it lived?
questions.x: Jesus compares his own lifting up to this (John 3:14).

questions.x: God gave him the covenant of an everlasting priesthood.

questions.q: What was a Nazarite to keep from?
questions.a: Wine, the razor, and touching the dead

questions.a: Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh
